name: Moegi Kazamatsuri
source:
Moegi Kazamatsuri is a kunoichi of Konohagakure. Moegi has dark blue eyes and orange hair. She is quite optimistic, free spirited and very confident. She has been described as being spoiled and determined. In her adulthood, Moegi has become quite strict, becoming easily angered by her team's childish antics or if they step out of line. As an adult she had advanced to the rank of Jonin, being capable of easily evading and countering [url=https://vndb.org/c105099]Sarada Uchiha[/url] while using her Sharingan. She's the captain of Team 10.

[In game description]
